disculpate.definition:
v. t. To free from blame or the imputation of a fault; to
   exculpate.
disculpate.translation:
vt. 开脱...的罪责
[法] 洗脱...罪责, 为...辩护

disculpating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Disculpate

discumber.definition:
v. t. To free from that which cumbers or impedes; to
   disencumber.

discursion.definition:
n. The act of discoursing or reasoning; range, as from
   thought to thought.
discursion.translation: n. 漫谈离题,[哲]推论,推理

discursive.definition:
s proceeding to a conclusion by reason or argument rather than intuition
s (of e.g. speech and writing) tending to depart from the main point or cover a wide range of subjects
discursive.translation: a. 离题的, 东拉西扯的

discursively.translation: adv. 东拉西扯地, 推论地

discursiveness.definition: n. the quality of being discursive

discus.definition:
n. an athletic competition in which a disk-shaped object is thrown as far as possible
n. a disk used in throwing competitions
discus.translation:
n. 铁饼, 掷铁饼比赛
[医] 盘, 板, [圆]片

discus interpubicus.translation: [医] 耻骨间盘, 耻骨间纤维软骨板

discuses.translation: n. 铁饼( discus的名词复数 )

discuss.definition:
n an athletic competition in which a disk-shaped object is thrown as far as possible
n a disk used in throwing competitions
v to consider or examine in speech or writing
v speak with others about (something); talk (something) over in detail; have a discussion
discuss.translation:
vt. 讨论, 论述
[医] 讨论, 辩论

discussant.definition: n. a participant in a formal discussion
discussant.translation: n. 讨论者, 商讨者

discussants.definition:
plural of discussant
n. a participant in a formal discussion
discussants.translation: (discussant 的复数) n. 讨论者, 商讨者

discussed.definition:
v to consider or examine in speech or writing
v speak with others about (something); talk (something) over in detail; have a discussion
discussed.translation: v. 商讨；讨论（discuss的过去分词）

discusser.definition: n. One who discusses; one who sifts or examines.
discusser.translation: n. 论述者, 讨论者

discusses.definition:
n. an athletic competition in which a disk-shaped object is thrown as far as possible
n. a disk used in throwing competitions
v. to consider or examine in speech or writing
discusses.translation: vt. 讨论；论述, 辩论

discussible.translation: a. 可议论的, 可讨论的

discussing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Discuss
discussing.translation: v. 谈论( discuss的现在分词 ); 讨论; 商量; 论述

discussion.definition:
n. an extended communication (often interactive) dealing with some particular topic
n. an exchange of views on some topic

discussional.translation: a. 讨论的, 提交讨论的

discussions.definition:
n. an extended communication (often interactive) dealing with some particular topic
n. an exchange of views on some topic
discussions.translation: n. 讨论( discussion的复数形式 ); 商讨; 详述; 论述

discussive.definition:
a. Able or tending to discuss or disperse tumors or
   coagulated matter.
a. Doubt-dispelling; decisive.
n. A medicine that discusses or disperses morbid humors; a
   discutient.

discutient.definition:
a. Serving to disperse morbid matter; discussive; as, a
   discutient application.
n. An agent (as a medicinal application) which serves to
   disperse morbid matter.
discutient.translation:
n. 消散药
a. 消肿的, 消散的
